integrity: The claim is limited to binary linear PIR codes under the standard disjoint-recovery-set definition. The finite verifier establishes the representative-code calculations used by the new lower bound; it does not claim an independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The lower-bound obstruction is independently replayed for the unique [17,8,6] equivalence class. The uniqueness classification and the published length-18 PIR upper bound are literature premises and are not re-enumerated or reconstructed from scratch in this package.
title: Exact value \(P(8,6)=18\) for binary six-PIR codes
